name: Frag Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Standard fragmentation grenade with a short fuse.
&7Cheap and reliable, but the blast is small.

name: Shrapnel Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Sprays metal fragments in all directions.
&7Shreds exposed players but barely scratches the terrain.

name: Molotov
descriptionLines: &7Perfect for area denial.

name: Bouncy Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Rebounds off walls and floors before blowing up.
&7Great around corners, but the bounce can come back at you.

name: Gas Canister Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Canister that floods the area with explosive gas before igniting.
&7The blast is huge, so throw it from a safe distance.

name: Strong Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Heavy-duty grenade with a noticeably bigger blast radius.
&7Tough on groups, risky in tight rooms.

name: Incendiary Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Sets the target area ablaze on impact.
&7Fire spreads over flammable blocks, so watch your own cover.

name: Breach Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Blasts a hole through walls and doors to open a new angle.
&7Loud, so everyone knows you are coming.

name: High-Explosive Grenade
descriptionLines: &7High-explosive impact grenade with a strong blast.
&7Small supply, but it wipes out cover and players alike.

name: Combustible Lemon
descriptionLines: &7Explosive lemon

name: Cluster Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Bursts into several bomblets after the initial blast.
&7Covers a wide area; stay out of the splash zone.

name: Burst Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Scatters a burst of smaller charges around the impact point.
&7Very strong against groups, wasteful against single targets.

name: Impact Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Detonates the moment it hits something.
&7No fuse to wait for, but it cannot be cooked or bounced.

name: MIRV Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Splits into multiple warheads that rain down over a wide area.
&7Devastating on groups; stay clear of the whole splash zone.

name: Smart Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Detonates when an enemy gets close to it.
&7Does not tell friend from foe, so keep your team clear.

name: Vortex Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Summons a vortex which sucks in blocks and players

name: Null Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Deletes a portion of the world

name: Mystery Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Hmmm

name: Low-Yield Nuclear Warhead
descriptionLines: &7Mini-nuke rounds for the Fat Man launcher (launcher included).
&7Huge blast and fallout, so fire from a safe distance.

name: Nuclear Warhead
descriptionLines: &7Full-size nuclear round for the Fat Man launcher (launcher included).
&7Devastating blast radius and lingering radiation.

name: High-Yield Nuclear Warhead
descriptionLines: &7The biggest nuclear round available for the Fat Man launcher (launcher included).
&7Wipes out most of the area; you will not survive it up close either.
